space.$description: 4px base, compact step set (2-48px), named by multiple of the base unit (space-2 is 8px). 28px and 36px steps added for control and row heights.

page-gutter.$description: Horizontal padding of the app frame and page containers (20px, from the approved composition).

section-gap.$description: Gap between panels and page regions (16px). Two steps above stack-gap, so groups read as groups by space alone.

panel-padding.$description: Inner padding of panels, the featured surface, popovers, and dialogs (16px, from the approved composition).

stack-gap.$description: Vertical gap between form fields and stacked blocks inside a panel (8px).

component-gap.$description: Gap between related controls: buttons in a toolbar, filters, fields in one row (8px).

field-gap.$description: Gap between a label and its input, or an icon and its text (4px).

cell-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding inside table cells and list rows (8px).

control-height.$description: Height of buttons, inputs, selects (28px, compact, from the approved composition).

row-height.$description: Table and list row height (36px; the composition showed 34px, rounded up to the 4px grid). Taller than controls so a row can hold a control.
